institution: Escuela Superior de Música Reina Sofía (centro privado autorizado), Madrid
programme_name: Máster en Enseñanzas Artísticas en Composición Dramática y para Ensemble Instrumental
official_status: OFFICIAL — Máster en Enseñanzas Artísticas (Enseñanzas Artísticas register, not RUCT). Plan de estudios homologado by Orden EFP/436/2022, de 9 de mayo (BOE-A-2022-8106). Not a título propio.
modality: NOT FOUND as an explicit statement — the plan de estudios page does not state presencial/online. All teaching, auditions and instrumental classes are on campus in Madrid, so it is de facto presencial, but no verbatim source states it.
language_of_instruction: "El idioma oficial de la escuela es el español"; "Las asignaturas instrumentales se pueden impartir en español o inglés" (Preguntas Frecuentes). Non-Spanish speakers are given "un curso intensivo de español en su primer año"; for the official Grado and Máster "será necesario un dominio de la lengua suficiente". No certificate level specified.
tuition_total_eur: 0 EUR tuition for the full 60-ECTS programme — "Todos los alumnos disfrutan de matrícula gratuita". The only student payment is "1.200 euros en concepto de reserva de plaza" (one-off place reservation), plus a 120 EUR audition inscription fee. Real cost of a place is stated as ~45.000 EUR/year, covered 100% by the Fundación Albéniz scholarship.
tuition_year_of_rates: 2026-27 (rates as published on the school site, accessed 2026-08-25)
non_eu_surcharge: No — no differentiated non-EU/non-resident tariff is published. "Todos los alumnos disfrutan de matrícula gratuita" is stated for all students and the FAQ states candidates of all nationalities are accepted on the same terms. Private centre, so autonomous-community precios públicos decrees do not apply.
complementary_credits_required: RUCT: not applicable — this title is in the Enseñanzas Artísticas register, which RUCT does not contain, so there is no RUCT complementos row. Admission page (for the applicant): no complementos de formación are mentioned; the stated requirement is "será necesario estar en posesión de alguna de las siguientes titulaciones: Grado en Enseñanzas Artísticas Superiores de Música, título universitario oficial de Graduado..." — i.e. any official Grado qualifies (consistent with art. 15 RD 1614/2009). The real gate is the audition ("el único criterio de selección es el talento"; ~9% admission rate).
application_window_2027: NOT YET PUBLISHED for curso 2027-28 (the September 2027 intake) as of 2026-08-25. Most recently published window, for curso 2026/2027: inscription open until "el próximo 17 de diciembre de 2025", with in-person auditions "entre febrero y marzo de 2026"; that window is now closed. By that pattern the 2027-28 window would open ~Oct 2026 and close ~Dec 2026, but no 2027-28 dates are published — dates NOT shifted forward here.
notes: Independently re-sourced 2026-08-25. Official status established from the BOE homologation order itself (BOE-A-2022-8106), which names the title verbatim as "Título de Máster en Enseñanzas Artísticas en Composición Dramática y para Ensemble Instrumental de la Escuela Superior de Música Reina Sofía de Madrid"; the school's own page cites "Resolución BOE 17 de mayo de 2022" for the same order. RUCT absence is EXPECTED here and is not evidence against officiality (per brief correction to rule 6); confirmed by grepping output/ruct-backbone.jsonl and output/ruct-detail.jsonl — zero conservatory-sector rows. The BOE text published online carries only the homologation order, not the curriculum annex, so ECTS comes from the school's own plan de estudios page: "El Máster en Composición Dramática y para Ensemble Instrumental consta de 60 Créditos Europeos (ECTS) que se deberán cursar en un curso académico." Programme exists and runs — it is listed in the school's 2026/2027 audition call. Candidate-fit caveat: this is a composition master entered by audition/portfolio in dramatic and ensemble composition, not a technology programme.

institution: Conservatorio Superior de Música de Aragón (CSMA), Zaragoza
programme_name: Máster en Enseñanzas Artísticas en Música Contemporánea
official_status: OFFICIAL — Máster en Enseñanzas Artísticas (Enseñanzas Artísticas register, not RUCT). Plan de estudios homologado by Orden ECD/579/2017, de 2 de junio (BOE-A-2017-7087); evaluated favourably by ACPUA (Agencia de Calidad y Prospectiva Universitaria de Aragón), not ANECA — which the brief confirms is normal for this register. Not a título propio.
ruct_code: BOE:BOE-A-2017-7087 (Orden ECD/579/2017, de 2 de junio); centre registration code 50010326
ects: 60 — "Nº de Créditos ECTS: 60 ECTS"; breakdown "Materias obligatorias: 42 ECTS · Materias optativas: 6 ECTS · Trabajo Fin de Máster: 12 ECTS" (Módulo 1 común 14 + Módulo 2 específico 28 = 42). "Duración del Máster: Un curso académico".
modality: presencial — "Modalidad: Presencial" and "Tipo de Enseñanza: Enseñanza presencial" (official CSMA máster information PDF). Taught in weekend blocks: "Viernes de 16 a 21:30 horas · Sábado de 9 a 21:30 horas · Domingo de 9 a 15 horas", on campus at Vía Hispanidad 22, 50009 Zaragoza.
language_of_instruction: NOT FOUND — no explicit "idioma de impartición" statement appears on the CSMA máster pages or in the official máster information PDF. All programme documentation, guías docentes and staff listings are in Spanish and there is no English-track claim, but no verbatim statement exists, so this is recorded as NOT FOUND rather than inferred.
tuition_total_eur: 2,535–2,565 EUR for the full 60-ECTS programme. Components quoted verbatim: "50€ solicitud de participación"; "100€ apertura de expediente"; "El importe de la matrícula estará en función de la selección de asignaturas optativas, oscilando entre 2.385€ y 2.415€". Arithmetic: 2,385 + 50 + 100 = 2,535 (low) and 2,415 + 50 + 100 = 2,565 (high).
tuition_year_of_rates: NOT FOUND — neither the CSMA inscription page nor the official máster PDF states which academic year these amounts apply to. Figures are as currently published on csma.es, accessed 2026-08-25. Legal basis is ORDEN ECD/1997/2017, de 19 de diciembre (BOA), which creates the precios públicos for Máster in enseñanzas artísticas superiores in Aragón, with amounts in an annex not reproduced in the BOA web text.
non_eu_surcharge: NOT FOUND — no differentiated non-EU / non-resident tariff is published for this programme. CSMA publishes a single matrícula figure with no nationality distinction, and ORDEN ECD/1997/2017 (the Aragón order creating máster enseñanzas-artísticas precios públicos) contains no non-EU provision in its dispositive text. Important negative check: Aragón's DECRETO 120/2026, de 24 de junio (BOA nº122, 29/06/2026), which carries the non-EU/non-resident pricing rule, fixes "los precios públicos por la prestación de servicios académicos universitarios para el curso 2026-2027" for the Universidad de Zaragoza only — it does NOT cover enseñanzas artísticas superiores, so that decree's non-EU rule cannot be applied here. Silence = NOT FOUND, not "no".
complementary_credits_required: RUCT: not applicable — Enseñanzas Artísticas register, which RUCT does not contain; confirmed zero conservatory rows in output/ruct-backbone.jsonl and output/ruct-detail.jsonl. Admission page (for the applicant): no complementos de formación are offered, because the degree bar itself is closed — "Será necesario estar en posesión del Título Superior de Enseñanzas Artísticas en la especialidad de Composición (Máster Música contemporánea/ itinerario composición) o el de la especialidad instrumental a la cual se presenta el alumno ... o a su equivalente expedido por una institución del Espacio de Educación Superior Europeo que faculte, en el país de expedición del título, el acceso a enseñanzas de máster." ⚠ This centre has narrowed the general rule: it demands a music Título Superior (or EHEA equivalent in the same specialty), NOT any official Grado as art. 15 RD 1614/2009 would allow. A Software Engineering degree does not meet it. Prueba de acceso, fase 1 (composición): "Presentar un máximo de tres obras escritas en los cinco últimos años, en formato partitura y grabación" — scores required; fase 2: "Entrevista y defensa de su candidatura ante el tribunal", which may be done by videoconference.
application_window_2027: NOT PUBLISHED with a year attached. The CSMA inscription page currently publishes the recurring annual calendar without a year: "Solicitudes: 10 al 30 de septiembre · Selección: 1 al 5 de octubre · Listado de admitidos: 6 de octubre · Matrícula: 7 al 15 de octubre"; the official máster PDF gives the same sequence dated "del 10 al 30 de septiembre de 2018" and "Plazo límite de presentación: 30 de septiembre." No 2027-28 dates are published as of 2026-08-25 — dates NOT shifted forward here. ⚠ Note the intake is not a September start: the PDF calendar runs "Primer semestre del 1 de noviembre ... Segundo semestre del 15 de marzo ... Trabajo Fin de Máster: del 1 al 15 de julio", i.e. teaching begins in November, so this does not match a clean September-2027 start.
notes: Independently re-sourced 2026-08-25. Official status established directly from the BOE homologation order, which names "Título de Máster en Enseñanzas Artísticas en Música Contemporánea del Conservatorio Superior de Música de Aragón" and records the ACPUA favourable report; the BOE web text carries the order only, not the curriculum annex, so ECTS/structure come from CSMA's own máster information PDF (extracted with pdftotext from https://csma.es/info-master-csma.pdf). RUCT absence is EXPECTED for this register and is not evidence against officiality. ⚠ Currency caveat: the CSMA máster PDF's calendar and administrative dates are from the 2018-19 cycle even though the file is the one currently linked from csma.es; the fee figures in it match the figures on the live inscription page, so the fees are current-as-published but carry no stated year. Programme appears to exist and run — CSMA's live "Nivel máster" page still lists both Máster en Enseñanzas Artísticas en Música Contemporánea and Música de Conjunto, and the inscription page is live. 12 plazas reported. Candidate fit: effectively CLOSED — the acceso rule requires a music Título Superior in composition or the instrument, and the composition prueba de acceso requires three written works in score form.

institution: Escola Superior de Música de Catalunya (ESMUC), Barcelona
programme_name: Màster oficial de Recerca Musical / Máster en Enseñanzas Artísticas en Investigación Musical
official_status: OFFICIAL — Máster en Enseñanzas Artísticas (Enseñanzas Artísticas register, not RUCT). Plan de estudios homologado by Orden ECD/578/2017, de 2 de junio (BOE-A-2017-7086), title verbatim "Título de Máster en Enseñanzas Artísticas en Investigación musical", centre "Escuela Superior de Música de Cataluña" registry code 08053561; evaluated favourably by AQU Catalunya and the Consejo Superior de Enseñanzas Artísticas; registration in the state registry confers initial accreditation. Not a título propio.
ruct_code: BOE:BOE-A-2017-7086 (Orden ECD/578/2017, de 2 de junio); centre registry code 08053561
ects: 60 — "Crèdits ECTS: 60" on ESMUC's own Catalan programme page. Calendar for the current edition: "Del 2 d'octubre de 2026 al 22 de maig del 2027" (one academic year).
language_of_instruction: "Idioma de docència: Castellà" — verbatim from ESMUC's own Catalan-language programme page (NOT from the English version). ⚠ The English version of the same page renders this as "Spanish", consistent, but the Catalan original is the citable statement. Separately the programme states a competence requirement to "communicate, understand and convey abstract concepts in more than one language and especially in English" — that is a competence, not the language of delivery.
tuition_total_eur: 3,760.20 EUR tuition for the full 60 ECTS, ~3,812.20 EUR all-in. Arithmetic: ESMUC's public-prices table lists "Màster d'Ensenyaments Artístics en Investigació Musical (MEAIM) – 62,67 €" per credit; 62.67 x 60 = 3,760.20. Add the mandatory "Preinscripció al Màster – 30,00 €" and "Assegurança escolar Màster – 22,00 €" = 3,812.20. The prices page states the official master's price "already includes a 40% discount, covered by the Department of Education".
tuition_year_of_rates: NOT STATED on the prices page — ESMUC's preus públics table carries no academic-year heading. Figures are as published and accessed 2026-08-25; the same site's programme calendar for this edition is 2026-27, so these are best read as 2026-27 rates, but no year is printed.
non_eu_surcharge: NOT FOUND — ESMUC's public prices page lists 13 official masters with a single per-credit price each and no non-EU / non-resident / no comunitari row anywhere in the table, and the programme page quotes the same 62,67 € to all applicants. Per the brief, page silence is NOT FOUND rather than "no". Note this is enseñanzas artísticas superiores priced by the Departament d'Educació, not a university título priced under Catalonia's Decret de preus públics universitaris, so the Decret 96/2026 non-resident rule does not automatically transfer here.
complementary_credits_required: RUCT: not applicable — Enseñanzas Artísticas register, absent from RUCT by design (confirmed: zero conservatory rows in output/ruct-backbone.jsonl and output/ruct-detail.jsonl). Admission page (for the applicant): no complementos de formación are stated. Three access routes are published: "Llicenciatura o grau en música"; "Grau universitari amb el grau mig en música"; "Grau universitari amb coneixements musicals però sense títol oficial". The third route explicitly admits a university graduate with no official music qualification, subject to a prova d'accés of three exercises — score analysis, aural analysis and transcription. Selection is then CV 60% / motivation letter 40%. 15 places.
application_window_2027: NOT YET PUBLISHED for the 2027-28 edition (an October 2027 start) as of 2026-08-25. The calendar currently published by ESMUC for master pre-registration gives three rounds with day-and-month only, no year: preinscripció "Del 2 de febrer al 25 de març" (acceptance 15 d'abril, matrícula 22–29 d'abril); "Del 4 de maig al 24 de maig" (acceptance 9 de juny, matrícula 17–25 de juny); "Del 6 de juliol al 6 de setembre" (acceptance 6–13 de setembre, matrícula 14–18 de setembre). These correspond to the 2026-27 intake whose teaching runs 2 Oct 2026 – 22 May 2027. Dates NOT shifted forward. No separate international/non-EU deadline is published.
notes: Independently re-sourced 2026-08-25. Official status established from the BOE homologation order itself; RUCT absence is expected for this register and is not evidence against officiality. Note a naming discrepancy worth flagging, not a conflict: the BOE title is "Investigación musical", ESMUC markets it in Catalan as "Màster oficial de Recerca musical", and its own price table calls it "Màster d'Ensenyaments Artístics en Investigació Musical (MEAIM)" — three names, one title. Also note the BOE describes ESMUC as a "Centro Privado Autorizado de Enseñanzas Superiores de Música" even though it is run by a public Catalan foundation. Language of instruction was taken from the Catalan original per brief rule 7; the /ca/ URL variant 404s, the canonical Catalan page is the path without a locale prefix. Programme exists and runs — a current 2026-27 edition with published dates and 15 places. Candidate relevance: this is the most open of the five for a non-music graduate, since route 3 admits a university graduate with musical knowledge but no official music title via a theory/aural prova d'accés (no performance audition, no scores required); but delivery is in Castellà, which this candidate does not yet have.

institution: Centro Superior de Enseñanza Musical Katarina Gurska (centro privado autorizado), Madrid
programme_name: Máster en Enseñanzas Artísticas en Investigación Musical Interdisciplinar
official_status: OFFICIAL — Máster en Enseñanzas Artísticas (Enseñanzas Artísticas register, not RUCT). Plan de estudios homologado by Orden EFP/587/2022, de 16 de junio (BOE-A-2022-10636), title verbatim "Título de Máster en Enseñanzas Artísticas en Investigación Musical Interdisciplinar", centre "Centro de Enseñanza Musical Katarina Gurska de Madrid" registry code 28040180; proposed by the Comunidad de Madrid, evaluated by the Fundación para el Conocimiento madri+d with a favourable report from the Consejo Superior de Enseñanzas Artísticas dated 10 May 2022. Not a título propio.
ruct_code: BOE:BOE-A-2022-10636 (Orden EFP/587/2022, de 16 de junio); centre registry code 28040180
ects: 60 — "60 ECTS"; "Duración: 10 meses de septiembre a julio" (centre's own Spanish programme page).
modality: presencial — "Modalidad: Presencial", delivered as "2 Encuentros al mes los fines de semana" (two weekend blocks per month) in Madrid.
language_of_instruction: "Idioma de impartición: Español" — verbatim from the centre's own Spanish-language programme page. The English mirror of the same page also states "Spanish", so the two agree. The Spanish page additionally states that international applicants must supply a DELE B2 Spanish diploma; the English mirror omits this requirement.
tuition_total_eur: CONFLICT — two figures published by the same centre for the same programme. (a) Spanish page: "500€ de matrícula + 6.500€ de curso académico" = 7,000 EUR total for the 60-ECTS programme, payable lump sum, in 2 instalments, or in 10 or 12 monthly instalments. (b) English mirror page: "5,500€ + 300€ tuition fee" = 5,800 EUR total. Both URLs are in sources. Neither figure is safe to act on without contacting the centre; the Spanish original would normally win under brief rule 7's logic, but that rule governs language, not price, so this is logged as an unresolved CONFLICT rather than silently resolved.
tuition_year_of_rates: NOT FOUND — neither the Spanish nor the English programme page states an academic year for its fee. Figures are as published and accessed 2026-08-25. For context the centre's separate admission page is running the "curso 26/27" cycle.
non_eu_surcharge: NOT FOUND — no differentiated non-EU / non-resident tariff is published. This is a private authorised centre in Madrid charging a single flat fee, so autonomous-community precios públicos decrees and their non-EU provisions do not apply. What international applicants face instead is a language gate, not a price gate: a DELE B2 Spanish diploma. Page silence on a surcharge = NOT FOUND, not "no".
complementary_credits_required: RUCT: not applicable — Enseñanzas Artísticas register, absent from RUCT by design (confirmed: zero conservatory rows in output/ruct-backbone.jsonl and output/ruct-detail.jsonl). Admission page (for the applicant): no complementos de formación are stated. The published requirement is an official degree — "Título Superior, Grado, Licenciatura o equivalente" — plus CV and motivation letter for profile evaluation, plus a personal interview (entrevista personal); this is the prueba de acceso and it is an interview, not an audition and not a written music test. International applicants additionally need DELE B2. 8 places.
application_window_2027: NOT FOUND — the centre publishes no application calendar or deadline for its másteres. Its "Proceso de admisión" page covers Grado Superior only and is running curso 26/27 (documentation "antes del 10 de julio 2026", access test July 2026, 50 EUR inscription fee deducted from 2026-27 tuition, accompanist requests and scores by 30 April 2026); those Grado dates do NOT govern the máster. No 2027-28 máster dates published as of 2026-08-25; dates NOT shifted forward. Admission to the máster appears to be rolling — applications are assessed and "la comisión de admisión comunicará el resultado al candidato por correo electrónico".
notes: Independently re-sourced 2026-08-25. Official status established from the BOE homologation order itself; RUCT absence is expected for this register and is not evidence against officiality. ⚠ The centre's own Spanish and English pages for this master disagree on price by 1,200 EUR (7,000 vs 5,800) — flagged as CONFLICT above rather than resolved. Programme exists and runs: 8 places, a September–July calendar, and the Fundación Katarina Gurska has publicly awarded five extraordinary scholarships specifically for the MIMI. Candidate relevance: the degree bar is generous (any Grado/Licenciatura), the prueba de acceso is an interview rather than an audition, and there is a scholarship stream — but delivery is entirely in Español and DELE B2 is a stated requirement for international applicants, which for a September 2027 intake this candidate would have to reach from A0/A1.
